program: Innofounder (Danmarks Innovationsfond / Innovationsfonden); the former Graduate track is now part of the single Innofounder programme
stopper_list: Each funded founder must have completed a higher education (rule of thumb at least 120 ECTS) before programme start; Jonas (90 ECTS, no degree) cannot be a funded founder, so at most Ida and Rasmus (2 x 27,500 = 55,000 DKK/month) unless the team changes (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/)

Diploma or study documentation for each applying founder, clearly showing the education requirement, attached at application; missing documentation means rejection without assessment (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 2, Bilag)

Each funded founder owns at least 12.5% of the company, documented (e.g. ejerbog) before start (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf sections 1.2 and 4.1)

Full time, at least 37 h/week, during the programme and at most 10 h/week other education or paid work, week by week; Rasmus must have left his full-time job (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/)

Active participation and physical attendance in the sparring/incubation programme (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2)

Company with Danish CVR number and NemKonto before programme start; not needed at application (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf sections 1.2 and 4.2; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/)
The company must hold the rights to commercial exploitation of the idea (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2)

The application must state who applies for admission and who is the rest of the team; founders cannot be added or replaced after the deadline, only removed (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2)

Apply only via e-grant before the deadline (weekday 12:00), no corrections afterwards, formal non-compliance means administrative rejection; no open call today: autumn 2026 closed 25 August 2026 and no next deadline is published (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf sections 2 and 3)

Inside the form: fixed questions with character limits (1000/1200), theme justification and milestone plan; CV max 2 pages per applicant; max 5 pages extra plus 5 pages LOI; attachments PDF, max 25 MB (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 2)

State-aid declarations at application: company (and any controlling parent) at most 5 years old, no distributed profit, not an undertaking in difficulty, at most 49 employees (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf sections 1.2 and 6)
A company can be admitted to Innofounder only once (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.2)

Idea past the idea stage with significant development left; no substantial revenue or external capital already raised; not mainly sales, marketing or scaling (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf section 1.3; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/)

B: Turn 2: Jonas's pay 'skal betales af andre penge' (must come from other money); guidelines section 1.4 leave it to the company how much of the monthly grant goes to salary and how much to other company purposes. B hedges with 'spørg fonden'.
